title: When anger rises quickly in the day as it is
issueStatement: The mind reacts before truth and proportion have time to speak. The pressure is not abstract anymore; it is meeting the ordinary shape of the day.
centralInsight: Guru turns the battle inward so reaction loses its claim to righteousness. Gurbani refuses to treat the ordinary day as spiritually irrelevant.
practicalReflection: The cure begins when ego is seen as illness rather than identity. Slow the tongue before you defend the self-image behind it.
actionPrompt: Slow the tongue before you defend the self-image behind it. Keep the response small enough to survive an ordinary day.

source.shortMeaning: Where does ego come from? How can it be removed?
source.lifeApplication: The cure begins when ego is seen as illness rather than identity. Let the wider window set the tone before the old reflex does.

excerpts.explanation: The line names the pressure without melodrama: where does ego come from? How can it be removed?.

source.shortMeaning: O Baba, speak only that which will bring you honor
source.lifeApplication: Guard the tongue, and the heart begins to clear. Let the wider window set the tone before the old reflex does.

source.shortMeaning: Hundreds of thousands of clever tricks, but not even one of them
